messages.subject: Explained variance
parts:
Dear all,

If your dependent variable is ordinal, how to do obtain (pseudo) R squared? Lavaan does provide an R squared, but can I just interpret this even with an ordinal dependent variable? 
If not, are there other ways to calculate (pseudo) R square measures?

Thank you!

Nathalie

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Explained variance
parts: If your dependent variable is ordinal, how to do obtain (pseudo) R squared? Lavaan does provide an R squared, but can I just interpret this even with an ordinal dependent variable?
If not, are there other ways to calculate (pseudo) R square measures?

If you are just running a path model with observed variables, then you can run a univariate model for the outcome of interest.  Different R packages (e.g., zelig) provide different pseudo-R-squareds for logistic regression models (e.g., Tjur's pseudo-R-squared).
